topics.title: Meet the Keyboard
topics.short: Low notes and high notes, white keys and black keys, and the groups of two and three black keys that work as your map.

topics.title: Finding C and the Musical Alphabet
topics.short: Find every C with the black keys as your guide, learn the seven letter names of the white keys, and meet octaves and middle C.

topics.title: Sitting and Hand Shape
topics.short: Where to sit, how high and how far away, and the relaxed, curved hand shape that makes playing feel easy.

topics.title: Finger Numbers
topics.short: Thumb is 1, little finger is 5, on both hands. Learn the numbers that music uses to tell you which finger plays which note.

topics.title: The C Position
topics.short: Five fingers on five white keys: where each hand goes in C position, how to keep it still, and your first notes with both hands. Then G position.

topics.title: Your First Notes: Steps and Skips
topics.short: Melodies move by steps (to the very next key), skips (over one key) and repeats. Play them, hear them, and see them on the page.

topics.title: Black Keys: Sharps and Flats
topics.short: Every black key has two names. Learn what sharp and flat mean, and the half steps and whole steps that every scale is built from.

topics.title: The Pedals
topics.short: What the right, left and middle pedals do on a grand piano, an upright and a digital piano, and how to use the sustain pedal lightly.

topics.title: How to Practice, and Your First Tunes
topics.short: Short daily sessions, slow first, hands separately then together, and the metronome. Then play your first songs with the notes lit up.
